title: Morphogenesis and regeneration share a conserved core transition cell state program that control lung epithelial cell fate
overall_design: Epcam+ or Epcam+Icam1+ cells from E14.5 mouse embroynic lungs are isolated and proceeded to single cell sequencing
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: Epcam+ Icam+ cells, replicate1
extract_protocol_ch1: To obtain a single cell suspension for scRNAseq, two C57/B6 females were euthanized and E14.5 embryos were collected. Lungs were dissected out and kept in ice-cold HBSS until the start of dissociation. Lungs were pooled and minced manually with a blade into pieces of ~1mm in diameter in 4ml dissociation buffer (0.8ml HBSS (1X), 2ml Dispase II, Stemcell Technologies #7913, 2.5 U/ml, 400μl Collagenase A, Roche #10103578001, 800ul DNase 1, 200ug/ml, Sigma, Cat# DN25) Dissociation followed in an insitu hybridization oven at 37°C for 1 hour on a rotator with gentle P1000 pipette trituration every 20 minutes. Then, ice-cold FACS buffer (2% FBS,2mM EDTA, 5μM Y27632, 1M HEPES in HBSS) was added, the suspension was filtered through a 70μm filter, spun down at 5 minutes at 400g, and incubated 5 minutes in red blood cell lysis buffer (sigma). The buffer was diluted with FACS buffer, spun down 5 minutes at 400g and resuspended in 1ml FACS buffer. The suspension was then passed through a 40μm filter, cells were counted and incubated 40 minutes with Epcam-APC antibody (1:150) and Icam1-PE antibody(1:150) on ice in the dark. After staining, the suspension was three times washed in FACS buffer and spun down 5 minutes at 400g. Finally, DAPI was added at a final concentration of 1μM in FACS buffer.

Single Cell 3’ libraries were prepared using the Chromium Single Cell 3’ v3 Protocol according to the manufacturer’s manual (10× Genomics). The pooled, 3’- end libraries were sequenced using Illumina NovaSeq6000
data_processing: Cellranger v2.1.1 was used for demultiplexing, alignment and mapping using Mus musculus reference genome v10 (mm10)
Supplementary files format and content: tab seperated values files and matrix files
